chapterTitle: Chapter 19 Aldehydes and Ketones: Nucleophilic Addition Reactions
title: Problem 19-5

pages.text: PROBLEM 19-5 Treatment of an aldehyde or ketone with cyanide ion (−:C N), followed by protonation of the tetrahedral alkoxide ion intermediate, gives a cyanohydrin. Show the structure of the cyanohydrin obtained from cyclohexanone.
